units.source_text: 但是，所幸人们不可能老是面临死的危险。

en.t: But fortunately, people cannot always be facing the danger of death.

units.source_text: 连冬天都无须害怕的人，能在季节性的发情中变得自由自在。

en.t: Those who no longer need to fear even winter can become free and easy in their seasonal rut.

units.source_text: 可是，战斗结束，武器反而会变成手脚的拖累。

en.t: Yet once the battle is over, weapons instead become a burden on one's hands and feet.

units.source_text: 这时“秩序”那家伙来了，代替自然，它弄到了牙、爪和性的管理权。

en.t: At that point, that fellow called “order” arrived and, in place of nature, got hold of the authority to manage teeth, claws, and sex.

units.source_text: 于是，性交也像通勤列车的联票一样，使用的时候，一定得请人用票钳打个洞。

en.t: And so sex too, like a commuter train coupon ticket, had to be punched with a ticket punch whenever it was used.

units.source_text: 而且，这种联票还得让人确定是否是真货。

en.t: Moreover, this kind of coupon ticket also had to be verified by someone as genuine.

units.source_text: 然而，还有令人害怕的烦琐东西，牢牢对应着这种“确认”以及“秩序之麻烦”，

en.t: Yet there were still frighteningly troublesome things, firmly matched to this “confirmation” and to the “trouble of order,”

units.source_text: 所有种类的证明书……合同书、资格证、身份证明书、使用许可证、权利书、认可书、

en.t: all kinds of certificates: contracts, qualification certificates, identity papers, permits for use, deeds of right, approvals,

units.source_text: 登记证、携带许可证、工会会员证、奖状、支票、借用证、临时许可证、承诺书、收入证明书、保管证，

en.t: registration certificates, carry permits, union membership cards, awards, checks, loan receipts, temporary permits, letters of commitment, income certificates, custody receipts,

units.source_text: 甚至到血统证明……看来是要把你所能想到的纸片，来一个总动员。

en.t: even pedigree certificates: apparently every scrap of paper you could think of was to be mobilized.
